articles.title: Aperiodic Alloy
articles.summary: Unequal inset tiles with interrupted bridges and scarred corners, a dense aperiodic metal mosaic. A fine hammered or pebbled metal grain; individual tiles disappear and it reads as an engineered, dimpled sheen.
articles.what: Unequal inset tiles meet interrupted bridges, multiway junctions and locally scarred corners. Up close: Dense field of rounded, bevelled tiles about 25 px across, each with a small inset square or dimple, packed like pebbles or a hammered-alloy mosaic with bright bridges between them. Tiles vary slightly in size and angle so it is not a perfect grid. From a distance: A fine hammered or pebbled metal grain; individual tiles disappear and it reads as an engineered, dimpled sheen. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: metal, roughness, clearcoat. Group: Experimental Structures (Surface library tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Surface library tab and the group "Experimental Structures", or search for "Aperiodic Alloy".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood, roof and doors: flat areas show the rim chains
Splitter and diffuser for a cast-metal feel
Numbers remain legible; the texture sits under them as fine grain.
Clear: bright ring chains in the lit band make a lively hammered satin
Pairs well with: matte, metallic, gloss.
pitfalls: Not hex scales: tiles are irregular and bevelled with inset squares
Not a Penrose paint tiling: it has no colour, only shine relief
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.title: Add it as an overlay
examples.goal: Layer Aperiodic Alloy over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.
